note: The original inputs cannot be reconstructed from the checked-in bitmap. A new generation emits a manifest with tokenizer/corpus/code content hashes, package versions and the exact invocation (draft_vocabulary_manifest.py). The vocabulary size is a performance compatibility assumption, not a tokenizer identity check. The nested 65536-token set reuses the saved historical ranking; see Qwen4DraftVocabularySizes.manifest.json.
